theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_cutoff_boundary_vanishes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M₁ : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (m + 1)), IsOpen U → T.boundary = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T₁ ω = ∫ x in M₁, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 1].restrict M₁), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ ‖α‖) → (∀ z ∈ M₁, ∃ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G ∧ z ∈ G ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ G → T₁ ω = c * T ω) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Z : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact Z ∧ μH[(m : ℝ)] Z = 0 ∧ closure M₁ ∩ K ⊆ M₁ ∪ Z) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C r₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < r₁ → μHE[m + 1] (M₁ ∩ ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ (m + 1))) → T₁.boundary = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
